name: Runner Extras - List Trappable Error
brief: Proves trappable collection errors surface BC's REAL error text, not a masked ArgumentNullException from the skeleton logging path.
description: RED before the fix: the skeleton NavServerEventSource is built with RuntimeHelpers.GetUninitializedObject, so its 'mutex' field initializer never ran (mutex == null). TrappableOperationExecutor.HandleError logs the caught exception BEFORE mapping/rethrowing it; the logging path reaches NavServerEventSource.get_NavServerEventViewerEvents whose body is lock(mutex) -> lock(null) -> ArgumentNullException 'Value cannot be null.' which REPLACES the real exception on every trappable error. GREEN after: an empty List of [Integer].Get(5) surfaces BC's real NavNCLArgumentOutOfRangeException text.
